guide_solution: Graph & Chart The graph shows us the preference of four team sports. Here we can see the students of class nine are divided in four team sports. The teams are soccer, football, baseball and hockey. We can also see the percentages of the interest in different sports. The involvement of the students in soccer is only 45 precent. The graph shows 55 percent students of class nine involves in football. The involvement of students in football is greater than that of soccer. On the other hand, the preference of the students in baseball is very poor. The perenentage of the students in baseball is only 25 percent. The graph shows they have less interest in baseball. But hockey is the most popular game among the students. The involvement of the students in hockey is higher than any other game in four sports. The percentage of the students in hockey is 75 percent which is higher than any other percentage. The graph here indicates the preference of the students of class nine in different sports like soccer, football, baseball and hockey. The number of students who prefer baseball is the lowest among four sports. The highest number of students shows interest in hockey sports. Though the football sports has the popularity among students but it holds the second position in the graph. The graph shows the preference of the sports among the young generation is declaring day by day.

subject: English
guide_solution: Story writing Once a golden neclace was lost from a rich mans house. A few servants worked in the house. Naturally it was First Paper  Solutions suspected that any one of servants had stolen the necklace. The rich man called all the servants in front of him. At first he asked them politely to give the necklace. But everyone was silent in front of him. They tried to understand him none of them stole the necklace. The richman was so much greedy and dishonest. He wanted to have the necklace at any cost. He began to show his cruelty to the poor servants. After that they did not agree they had stolen the necklace. The man started to give them rod brutally. After that they tried to prove themselves that they were not guilty. The owner of the necklace was getting furious. He applied all kinds of punishment over them. But he did not get any positive reply. At last he targeted the younger servant who worked in the rooms of his house. He brought him in front of his house. There was a crowd. He started to torture him much. He gave him rod bitterly. But the younger servant did not prove himself as a thief. After getting much rod he was losing his sense. At a point due to have much rod he was about to die. Everybody who were there and observing the cruelty of the richman began to hate the greedy man. They blamed the greedy man for the worst condition of the poor boy. The situation was getting worsen and going out of control. At that moment a loud voice was heard. "I have found! I have found! I have found the necklace!" The greedy richman started to run to have the necklace. He asked his wife where the necklace was. The wife replied that the necklace was in the nest of the magpie in the house.  Title : Nacklace of a rich man
